prefix_vs_random.note: Random 400-attack subsets drawn without replacement from the FULL attack order, each with the 97-benign census. A random 400 is a different experiment from the frozen prefix; this measures how different.

threshold_sensitivity.note: Descriptive sensitivity only: decisions re-derived from the engine's own recorded risk_score. No swept threshold is promoted to headline and the frozen threshold is not changed.
